faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Embroidered Uniform & Club Patches?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Embroidered Uniform & Club Patches is 100 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $1.35/pc (100 pcs starter tier), $0.75/pc (500 pcs tier), and $0.48/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Embroidered Uniform & Club Patches, and when is it waived?

faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Up to 9 Pantone Thread Colors. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Embroidered Uniform & Club Patches?
